snippet.title: The Wolf Among Us Remastered | Official Noir Mode Trailer | Out October 29
snippet.description:
The Wolf Among Us Remastered launches October 29, 2026.

Introducing the all-new Noir Mode: Play the entire story in a striking black-and-white presentation inspired by classic noir cinema. Switch it on at any time. Every interrogation, back alley, and hard choice plays out like the detective film Fabletown always deserved. With one tap, jump between Noir Mode and the fully remastered look whenever you want.

Step back into Fabletown in the definitive edition of Telltale's acclaimed noir narrative thriller, inspired by DC's award-winning Fables comic series. Fully remastered with enhanced visuals and modern presentation, this definitive edition brings Bigby Wolf's first investigation to life with greater atmosphere, immersion, and detail than ever before.

Investigate brutal murders, interrogate suspects, explore crime scenes, and uncover a conspiracy hiding beneath the streets of Fabletown, where myths and legends live secretly among us. Every choice carries consequences.

Fairy tales are real. Murder is just the beginning.

Available October 29, 2026.
